open_points.subject: read_mark
open_points.text: read_mark: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _mark_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PublicationMark those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, valid against = models.PublicationMark with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The required encoding must be placed in a data-provider constant added to IMPORTS and named as `the imported X constant`, rather than requiring the generator to guess which JSON standard and encoding are intended.

open_points.subject: read_placement
open_points.text: read_placement: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _placement_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PhotoPlacement those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, valid against = models.PhotoPlacement with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.
